title: explainer diagrams/swimlanes data
description: Lanes x columns grid, one optional box per cell, optional arrows between cells. Validated by lib/includes.mjs's handleDiagram against the same built-ins-only subset lib/schema.mjs interprets (type, minLength, minItems, properties, required, additionalProperties, items) — see core/diagrams/swimlanes/README.md. Cross-references (a cells key naming an unknown column, an arrow naming an unknown lane:column) aren't schema-expressible and are checked by render.mjs itself.

title.description: Diagram <title>, for accessibility; falls back to "Swimlanes".

columns.description: Grid columns, left to right in array order.

id.description: Referenced by lanes[].cells keys and arrows[].from/to.

label.description: Column header; wraps to the column's width budget.

lanes.description: Grid rows, top to bottom in array order.

label.description: Row header; wraps to the row-header width budget.

cells.description: Keyed by a columns[].id; a column with no key here is drawn as an empty cell.

new.description: Draws the cell's box with the shared "new" class instead of "same". Takes precedence over "changed" if both are set.

changed.description: Draws the cell's box with the shared "changed" class instead of "same".

panel.description: A contents.json page panels[].key; makes the cell a clickable node.

arrows.description: Connectors drawn after every cell, each between two cells that must both exist.

from.description: "laneId:columnId" of a lane with a cell at that column.

to.description: "laneId:columnId" of a lane with a cell at that column.
